turns.player: I ask the night porter how much the mash costs.
turns.gm: Night Porter says, "I do not know enough to answer that."

turns.player: I ask the night porter when the kiln crew actually left.
turns.gm: Night Porter shakes their head. "I won't answer that about night—not here."

turns.player: I ask the night porter how many bricks are left in that stack.
turns.gm: Night Porter says, "I do not know enough to answer that."

turns.player: I ask the night porter who last read that tally slate.
turns.gm: You examine the tally slate. Closer looking yields nothing further.

turns.player: I ask the night porter who recaulked the chimney flue, and how many tilers did the job.
turns.gm: Night Porter says, "I do not know enough to answer that."

turns.player: I ask the night porter what sits on the brazier.
turns.gm: Night Porter mutters, "Word is, a kettle of mash sits on the porter's brazier."
